---
title: "Synthetic model helper tests"
output: html_notebook
---

**Measures:** whether category encoding, missing-response handling, weighting, and the run-file naming convention behave as expected using synthetic data.


## Load shared code

Loads shared helpers without incrementing the actual research counter.

```{r load-shared-code}
# Set the project root, then load R code from the shared R Notebooks.
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
    current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
    repeat {
        if (file.exists(file.path(current, "FMD_Project.Rproj"))) {
            return(current)
        }
        parent <- dirname(current)
        if (identical(parent, current)) {
            stop("Open FMD_Project.Rproj in RStudio first")
        }
        current <- parent
    }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

load_module <- function(name) {
    path <- file.path(project_root, "R", paste0(name, ".Rmd"))
    text <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
    starts <- which(startsWith(text, "```{r"))
    ends <- which(trimws(text) == "```")
    blocks <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
        finish <- ends[ends > start][1]
        if (is.na(finish) || finish <= start + 1L) {
            stop("Missing code or closing fence in ", path)
        }
        paste(text[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n")
    })
    eval(parse(text = paste(blocks, collapse = "\n\n")), envir = parent.frame())
    invisible(TRUE)
}

load_module("config")
load_module("run_manager")
load_module("helpers")
```


## Assert helper behavior

Checks that missing inputs are encoded, FMD missing labels stay missing, AUROC handles ties, and the output suffix contains an increment.

```{r assert-helper-behavior}
check_packages(c("data.table", "Matrix"))
synthetic <- data.table::data.table(
    YEAR = c(2021L, 2021L, 2021L, 2021L),
    STATE = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L),
    STRAT = 1L,
    PSU = c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L),
    RAW_WEIGHT = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
    FMD = c(0, 1, NA_real_, 1),
    AIAN_ALONE = c(TRUE, FALSE, NA, TRUE),
    PHYSHLTH_DAYS = c(0, 14, NA_real_, 5),
    GENHLTH_CLEAN = c(1, NA_real_, 3, 2),
    AGE_BAND = c("18-34", "35-49", "50-64", NA_character_),
    SEX_CLEAN = c("Female", "Male", "Female", "Male"),
    EDU_CLEAN = c("HS", "College grad", NA_character_, "Some college"),
    INCOME_BAND = c("<25k", NA_character_, "75k+", "25-49k")
)
processed <- prepare_features(synthetic)
stopifnot(all(!is.na(processed[, ..feature_names])))
stopifnot(processed$INCOME_BAND[2] == "Missing")
stopifnot(!valid_outcome(processed$FMD[3]))
stopifnot(abs(weighted_auc(c(0, 1), c(0.5, 0.5), c(1, 1)) - 0.5) < 1e-12)
stopifnot(abs(weighted_mean(c(0, 1), c(1, 3)) - 0.75) < 1e-12)
# Test the artifact naming convention without creating any real run or artifact.
run_context <- list(id = "0042", models = tempdir())
stopifnot(grepl("_run_0042\\.rds$", artifact_path("models", "05_logistic")))
rm(run_context)
cat("[PASS] Synthetic input, categories, metrics, and run-suffix tests.\n")
```
